description_en: Creates a scheduled inspection task for one or more instances
description_zh: 创建一个新的批量实例定时巡检配置
kebab_example: aliyun rdsai create-scheduled-task --name 'RDS巡检' --description '定时RDS实例巡检任务' --instance-ids rm-2ze6mk259v3220000,rm-2zef3b65430j00000 --start-time 02:00:00Z --frequency Monday --time-range 24 --report-language zh-CN --report-type example-string --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --report-region-id example-string --inspection-items example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateScheduledTask

parameters.help_en: The name of the scheduled inspection task. The maximum length is 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 定时巡检任务名称（不超过64字符）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the scheduled inspection task
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the instances for the task. Use commas (,) to separate multiple IDs
parameters.help_zh: 关联实例ID列表, 多个取值用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The execution time for the scheduled inspection task. Specify the time in the HH:mm:ssZ format (UTC time). The default is 02:00:00Z
parameters.help_zh: 执行巡检任务的时间。格式：HH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）。默认凌晨2点
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The inspection frequency. Use commas (,) to separate multiple values. The default is DAILY. Valid values:

- DAILY: Every day

- Monday: Monday

- Tuesday: Tuesday

- Wednesday: Wednesday

- Thursday: Thursday

- Friday: Friday

- Saturday: Saturday

- Sunday: Sunday

### Note: DAILY overrides weekly values. For example, if you enter DAILY,Monday, the system uses DAILY as the inspection frequency
parameters.help_zh:
新的巡检频率，多个取值用英文逗号（,）隔开，默认为DAILY。取值：
* DAILY：每天
* Monday：周一
* Tuesday：周二
* Wednesday：周三
* Thursday：周四
* Friday：周五
* Saturday：周六
* Sunday：周日
### 注意：DAILY会覆盖周时间，例如填写DAILY,Monday后端会取DAILY作为巡检频率
parameters.name: frequency

parameters.help_en: The time range of data to inspect, in hours. Valid values are from 1 to 168 (7 days). The default is 24
parameters.help_zh: 巡检时间范围，默认最近24小时，取值：1~168（最大支持7天）
parameters.name: time_range

parameters.help_en: The report language. The default value is zh-CN. Supported values: zh-CN, zh-TW, ja-JP, and en-US
parameters.name: report_language

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the report is stored
parameters.name: report_region_id
